items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: and I got the key for Eberly

ctx.x: Far more so than today, you know.

And I did some things with him. I didn't even name the tunes, you know, but I'd bring it, and I (unintelligible) and it would have a nice little beat to it. This is all he wanted -- and the big band sound, of course. And I remember, though, that I had made a couple of popular tunes for him, and I got the key for Eberly, one of the things, you know, (unintelligible) -- I'm trying to recall what the name was. I may get back to it, but this is the story on Jimmy.
Did you -- did it make any difference to you, as far as your feelings when you were writing arrangements, instrumental arrangements or backups for vocals, did it?
